question: Mateo keeps his coin collection in a wooden box that holds 132 coins. His grandfather gives him 53 coins from his travels. Mateo buys 26 coins at a collectors' fair and finds 20 more at a flea market. A school friend then gives him 66 coins that she no longer wants. How many coins are in Mateo's box now?

Tess's drive from her home to the coastal office was 162 kilometres each way. Roadworks forced a detour that added 45 kilometres, but a new bridge then cut 114 kilometres off the route. Her car uses about 6 litres of fuel per 100 kilometres. She drives the finished route on each of 7 days, and on each day she covers it 2 times, once out and once back. How many kilometres does Tess drive over the 7 days?

In the morning, 219 students were on the list for the museum trip, but 29 were absent. Then 26 students from another class were added to the list. In the afternoon each student on the final list paid 8 dollars for the trip. In the evening the teachers added 44 dollars of their own to the trip fund. The school office counts the coins in cents and records the fund in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars are in the trip fund?

Wen's newsletter had 199 subscribers, more than the 150 that Li's newsletter had. After a dull issue, 74 people unsubscribed, and 16 addresses bounced and were removed. Each issue of the newsletter is 4 pages long. A post about the newsletter then went viral, and the subscriber list grew to 9 times its size. The next day 9 more people joined. How many subscribers does Wen's newsletter have now?

The new stadium has 220 seats in every row, 7 rows in every section, and 8 sections in total, and half of the seats are painted red. For the opening match, 4579 seats went unsold. In addition, 39 standing tickets were sold. The match lasted 90 minutes. How many spectators attended the opening match?

Farah had 102 stamps in her album, which has 30 pages, and that was more than the 90 stamps her cousin Idris had. She gave 73 stamps to Idris, then bought 49 at a fair. Her uncle sent her 70 stamps, and she swapped for 46 more at a club she visits twice a month. Each of her stamps is worth 6 cents, and she also has 10 cents in a coin tucked into the album. How many cents are Farah's stamps and coin worth together?

Emeka's poultry farm has 227 hens, more than the 200 hens on Ngozi's farm. He buys 63 more hens. Each hen lays 7 eggs in a week. Of that week's eggs, 621 are cracked and thrown away. He sells every remaining egg for 9 naira. He also earns 67 naira from selling feathers and 60 naira from selling manure. How many naira does Emeka earn that week?

Amal's bookshop received 129 copies of a new novel, and a dozen customers had already reserved theirs. A second delivery brought 52 more copies, and 3 review copies were added to the shelf. During launch week, when the shop stayed open 9 hours a day, 164 copies were sold. Amal then sold each remaining copy to a library for 7 dollars, and the library also paid 48 dollars for delivery. How many dollars did the library pay in total?

A bakery made 230 cupcakes and divided them equally among 5 charity stalls. The park stall also received 67 muffins to sell alongside its cupcakes. Every cupcake and muffin at the park stall sold for 9 cents. The stall also collected 60 cents in tips in the morning and 48 cents in tips in the afternoon. The volunteers wrote the total down in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents did the park stall collect altogether?

In the morning, each of the 8 tankers at a dairy collected 226 litres of milk from the farms, and each tanker then took on 5 more litres at the gate. In the afternoon, a small farm delivered another 51 litres to the dairy's storage tank, and 919 litres were sold to a supermarket. In the evening, 549 litres were sent to the cheese room. The dairy's gauge shows kilolitres, but the manager keeps her records in litres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres of milk remain in the storage tank?

In the morning, Zara's savings jar held 141 dollars, and she added 53 dollars from her birthday and 55 dollars from selling old toys. In the afternoon her mother divided the jar's money equally among 3 jars, one for each of the children, and Zara kept only her own jar. Her grandmother then put 76 dollars into Zara's jar. In the evening her father promised to double whatever was in Zara's jar, and he did. How many dollars are in Zara's jar now?

In the morning, Tobias set out with 140 flyers for the town fair, more than the 120 flyers his friend Klara was carrying. By midday he had handed out 61 flyers. In the afternoon he handed out 65 more, and 6 blew away in the wind. The town has 30 streets. In the evening he returned the flyers he still had to the printer, who paid him 4 cents for every flyer returned. How many cents did the printer pay Tobias?

Grace's farm loads 189 sacks of potatoes onto each of 4 lorries, while Henry's farm manages only 150 sacks per lorry. A small van brings 50 more sacks from Grace's barn to join her load. Each sack weighs 5 kilograms. The pallets and wrapping add another 32 kilograms. The journey to the market takes 3 hours. How many kilograms does Grace's whole load weigh?

Ivan's vineyard is planted with 102 vines in every row, 9 rows in every block, and 8 blocks in all, which is more vines than the 5000 on Olga's vineyard next door. A late frost kills 6772 of Ivan's vines. He replants 49 new vines in the spring. The harvest takes 12 days each autumn. How many vines does Ivan have now?

A candle maker packed her stock into 46 cartons, and a dozen helpers carried them. Each carton holds 4 bags, and each bag holds 4 candles. She also had 23 candles on the counter and 13 candles in the window display. She then shared all the candles equally among 4 market stalls, one of which was the Bay stall. How many candles did the Bay stall receive?

In the morning, each of 4 delivery vans brought 211 litres of orange juice to a festival tent. Before lunch a volunteer carried in 55 more litres. In the afternoon 123 litres were served to the crowd. In the evening a late van dropped off 13 litres more. The tent manager logs the juice in litres although the supplier bills in kilolitres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres of juice are in the tent now?

In the morning, Aisha had collected 77 signatures for her petition, more than the 60 that Bilal had collected. Before lunch she collected 29 more. In the afternoon she gathered 35 signatures at the market and 54 outside the library. In the evening she collected 73 signatures at a concert and 13 at the bus station. How many signatures does Aisha have?

In the morning, Chen made 207 portions of noodles and then made a second batch of exactly the same size, doubling his stock, while Wei's stall next door had 350 portions. By midday Chen had sold 113 portions. In the afternoon a helper brought 17 more portions. Chen packed 6 dumplings with every portion still on the stall. In the evening he divided all those dumplings equally into 6 boxes. How many dumplings are in the first box?

In the morning, Dario's bike shop had 171 bicycles in stock, more than the 150 in Elsa's shop. By midday he had sold 101 bicycles, and 4 more were found to be damaged and removed. In the afternoon he fitted 8 reflectors to every remaining bicycle. He also had 9 spare reflectors in a drawer. In the evening a courier delivered 16 more reflectors. How many reflectors does Dario have in the shop?

Fenna keeps a sourdough starter that weighs 87 grams, more than the 80 grams of starter her friend Gus keeps. She uses 85 grams of it in a loaf. She then feeds what is left with flour and water until it weighs 8 times as much. The next day she feeds it again until it weighs 8 times as much as before. Her oven bakes at 230 degrees. Finally she divides the starter into 2 equal portions and keeps only 1 portion in the jar. How many grams of starter are in Fenna's jar now?

Hamid ordered prints of his 121 holiday photos, and he had each photo printed twice. He gave 192 prints to family and friends. He then found 9 extra prints in the envelope, threw away 11 blurry ones, and received 3 prints back from his aunt. He sold every print he had left for 4 cents each at a school fair. He prices things in cents but records the total in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents did Hamid make from the sale?

In the morning, a farm shop had 67 boxes of eggs in the storeroom, and a dozen customers were already queuing outside. A delivery of 70 more boxes arrived before lunch. In the afternoon 36 boxes were sent to a restaurant in a van that is 5 metres long. In the evening the shopkeeper counted the eggs: each remaining box holds 4 trays, and each tray holds 6 eggs. How many eggs are in the storeroom?

Lina had 73 cents in her purse, and she checks her purse twice a day. She spent 32 cents on a stamp. She found 37 cents under the sofa and put them in her purse, and her brother paid her 65 cents for a bookmark. She then spent 73 cents on a hair clip. She thinks of her money in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents are in Lina's purse now?

Marta earns 30 dollars for each dog she walks, and on Saturday she walks 3 dogs. She also earns 57 dollars for looking after a cat. She spends 58 dollars on groceries and gets a 10 dollar tip from a grateful owner. She then spends 40 dollars on fuel. She keeps her receipts in cents but totals her money in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars does Marta have from the day?

The wood shed behind Petra's cabin held 74 logs at the start of December. She burned 29 logs in the first cold week, then 10 logs the next week, and 22 logs over the holidays. A neighbour delivered 72 logs to the shed in January. In the following week Petra burned 21 more logs. How many logs are in the shed now?
